1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder that is __solder paste__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and wherein the binder is premixed solder paste having a thermal conductivity greater than epoxy__.

3. (Original) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.
